market_summary: Tech stocks surged with Nasdaq up 0.41% to 22,776.33 and S&P 500 gaining 0.15% to 6,871.97, as the Supreme Court struck down Trump's tariffs boosting Alphabet and Amazon. The FTSE 100 hit a fresh record high, though some analysts warn of crash fears with the S&P 500 remaining range-bound. Investors remain cautious amid prediction market signals and Fed warnings, though tech leadership provides support.
